name: Mumbai - Ahmedabad High Speed Rail Project (MAHSR - Bullet Train)
bottleneck: Undersea Tunneling (Package C2) & Right-of-Way in Palghar District
bottleneckDesc: Complex excavation for 21 km twin undersea tunnel between BKC and Shilphata, coupled with forest rights verification in Maharashtra.
impact: Critical path slippage affecting track laying and electrical traction sub-station commissioning.
affectedActivity: Civil tunnel boring and Japanese E5 series Shinkansen rolling stock integration
riskFurther: High sensitivity to specialized tunnel boring machine maintenance cycles.
rootCause: Undersea geological faults & deep bedrock tunneling clearances
Forest Rights Act (FRA) settlement for viaduct piers
Integration of Japanese Shinkansen signaling and electrical substations
actionText: Cabinet Secretariat escalation to Maharashtra State Government for final utility corridors and direct monitoring via PM GatiShakti NPG.
expectedImpact: Accelerates package C2 tunneling progress by 4 months
Ensures Gujarat section operational launch readiness

name: Delhi - Ghaziabad - Meerut Regional Rapid Transit System (Namo Bharat RRTS)
bottleneck: Underground Station Caverns & Sarai Kale Khan Multi-Modal Integration
bottleneckDesc: Civil structural completion of underground platforms and inter-modal transfer links connecting Indian Railways, Metro, and ISBT.
impact: Timeline dependency for final continuous high-speed train testing up to 160 km/h.
affectedActivity: Station interior electricals, PSD synchronization and track handover
riskFurther: Moderate timeline risk managed by parallel commissioning of operational priority sections.

expectedImpact: Brings forward full corridor commissioning by 3 months
Opens direct regional high-speed transit for 800,000 daily commuters

name: Ken-Betwa Linking Development Project (National River Interlinking)
bottleneck: Stage-II Forest & Wildlife Clearance in Core Panna Tiger Reserve Corridor
bottleneckDesc: Daudhan Dam reservoir submergence requires diversion of 6,017 hectares of forest land within Panna Tiger Reserve. Civil execution is statutorily frozen pending Supreme Court Central Empowered Committee (CEC) compliance and final National Board for Wildlife (NBWL) landscape management clearance.
impact: Complete legal halt on Daudhan dam foundation civil excavation and canal tunneling works.
affectedActivity: Daudhan Dam concrete gravity wall, powerhouse civils & 221 km link canal excavation
riskFurther: Extreme sensitivity to NGT environmental appeals and compensatory afforestation land title mutation.
rootCause: Submergence of 4,141 ha of core tiger habitat in Panna National Park
Supreme Court CEC conditions on wildlife corridor mitigation and downstream Ken Gharial Sanctuary flow
Inter-state water sharing agreement dispute resolution between Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh
actionText: High-level apex steering committee intervention via Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) and Supreme Court Empowered Committee to operationalize the Integrated Landscape Management Plan (ILMP) and release compensatory afforestation parcels.
expectedImpact: Unblocks Stage-II forest clearance statutory compliance within 4.5 months
Allows contractor mobilization for Daudhan Dam diversion tunnel

name: Development of Zaheerabad Node (Hyderabad Nagpur Industrial Corridor)

impact: High risk of slowing industrial plot allotment and ground infrastructure preparation.
affectedActivity: Trunk Infrastructure & Internal Road Civil Works

expectedImpact: Accelerate statutory environmental approvals by 6-9 months
Enable contractor mobilization for internal road and drainage networks
Unlock ₹12,000+ Cr private industrial capex investments
